title: Unit Event — That day, the Sky was Far Away

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away
meta.Outline: Shiho feels a great sense of fulfillment after Leo/need successfully reaches its ticket quota and performs in perfect sync for the audience. She recalls the time she spent on her own back in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Mic check's done!
We should be all good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(There's a nice buzz in the air too.
You can always feel the anticipation building during moments like these.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They should as long as they didn't get lost somewhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see them...!
There! Towards the middle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's Haruka! Everyone else too!
I'm glad they all managed to find this place!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's Minori and Kohane... Shiraishi too. I guess they all came together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't believe we're really at the live house where Shii and her friends perform! I'm so glad we made it in time too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same...
Looks like leaving early just in case was a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku's here too along with everybody else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's the case, we should be able to give them a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were able to reach our ticket quota because we all worked together, which was a huge relief...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thanks for helping out with that Ichika, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You don't have to thank us!
We're going pro together, right? This is the least we could do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Selling tickets on top of writing our own songs... We have a lot on our plate, but that's all the more reason for us to work together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's show everyone just how much we appreciate them by giving them a good performance today.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Leo/need, get ready to take the stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think it's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
I finally get to see Shiho's band perform live!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm really glad for you.
It's sort of been a shame that you couldn't see them sooner because of our streams.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure a lot of you here today will be hearing us for the first time, but we hope to give you the best performance we can!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This is awesome!
There's really nothing like a live concert!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Alright, we're in good shape.
The crowd's getting into it more than usual. And...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're playing like we really mean it today. This might be the most fun I've seen them have so far...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, let's throw in one of these...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wooow...!
Did you see what Shiho just did?! That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was.
And I can feel their music resonating throughout my body...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More. I want to play some more.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (On top of having an audience to play for, we're all chasing after the same dream...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My old self might not even recognize me right now...)

Ugh...
We shouldn't have invited you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I couldn't see myself playing in another band, let alone with these three...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey...!
Is it just me or did we sound a little different today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, I felt that too...!
It's like we really gave it everything we had...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean, Ichi, Hona!
We played sooo unbelievably well!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We really did. Our individual sounds melded together for each song... It was an incredible feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can we keep playing?!
Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Hey, the next band needs to get set up! Mind moving your instruments for us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
We'll do that right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, once we've put everything away, we'll join the crowd and see what we can learn from the other bands.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho!
Why'd you run off like that? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you see someone you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I thought I did...
But I might've just gotten their faces mixed up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Reminiscing about what happened back then might've made me see what I wanted to see.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
We should get back before the next band gets started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, here's to our show yesterday going amazingly well...! Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try not to spill any juice, alright, you two?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin's totally gonna trip and fall at some point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll be fine!
See? My drink's on my desk and I'm using a straw!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, Len, raise your glass! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, cheers.
Hey, this juice is pretty good...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, a rooftop afterparty turned out to be such a great idea.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki suggested it on our way home yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when we decided to bring some food and drinks to celebrate...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your apple pies really never disappoint, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know they're good, Miku, but leave some for the rest of us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I've only had a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sorry.
You seemed to be really enjoying yourself so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Everything okay, KAITO?
What are you doing all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-It's not that I don't like parties or anything. I'm just not used to them is all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I usually play or perform by myself, so I have a hard time figuring what to do in these sorts of situations when everyone's involved...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, I think I understand how you feel. There was a time when I spent a lot of time by myself...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Ever since I was little, I've always been a bit of a lone wolf when it comes to doing the things I want.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, the flip side of that involved me not being great at interacting with others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
But I think I can empathize...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm not gonna lie...
Crowds and parties really aren't my thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But things are different for me here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because Ichika and the girls mean so much to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our show yesterday even felt like a dream to me. For a moment there, I couldn't believe that I was actually playing in a band with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But during junior high, I put a lot of distance between myself and the others because of my personality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why playing in a band together like this feels dreamlike at times...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiiihhooo!!
You've gotta try these! They're so crispy!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wah!
Wh-What is it, Saki? They're just chips, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She wants you to try this new flavor of potato chips, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, is that what this is about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm?
What were you and Shiho talking about, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? Um...
What were we talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait! Is it supposed to be a secret?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
N-No, not really...
Shiho was just telling me about herself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I was just telling him how I didn't expect to be playing in a band with all of you like before.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
During junior high...
When all I did was play my bass by myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika, Honami...
You don't need to look so concerned. Not now at least.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, Shiho, can you tell me more about what happened back then...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to know more because I really didn't get to go to school much during junior high...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kinda want to hear more about you during that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But telling her about that time won't really...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear as well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
That goes for everyone, including you, Shiho. I want to know more about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is, as long as you're okay with it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. You don't have to if you're not comfortable with it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'd like to hear someday as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe sharing what happened in the past will bring you all closer together and become a great source of strength...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
I've never really had the chance to talk about what happened back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So I'll do that now.
When I was in junior high...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, wait... Should we invite Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
No, don't bother.
You never know when she's gonna snap.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line: True. I remember telling her a little joke about some other girls this one time and she told me not to talk about them behind their backs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally.
You're talking about Mochizuki and Hoshino, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't have lunch with any of you even if you asked...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line: What was that?! Who does she think she is...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Just being in that classroom makes my nerves fray...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (People who don't conform are considered outsiders and tossed aside...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know I can handle those kinds of situations better, but it's just...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line: What's the name of that girl who always comes to talk to Hinomori? Hoshino or something? How's she able to put up with Hinomori like that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line: No idea. However, I heard that they've known each other since they were little... They're alike in a way, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know what you're talking about. They're both pretty blunt and don't care about what happens around them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line:
And they think they're so cool too.
It's like they believe they're too good for any of us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(No, I can't just ignore them...
They have no right talking about Ichika or anyone else like that...)

rows.Speaker: Junior
rows.Line:
Yes...
There's something that I've been meaning to ask you, Mochizuki. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
Why don't we have lunch together down by the courtyard while we talk?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Another girl from the brass band's asking her for advice. I guess it makes sense. Honami's nice and really reliable...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika told me that you've been acting strange lately. Did something happen? You can always ask me if there's anything that's bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's something I need to do...
Bye...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But this is how things need to be...
This way, Honami and Ichika won't have to...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you tell me to leave you alone the other day?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You haven't been reading my messages either. Have you been talking to Saki at all?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know exactly what I meant by what I said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have time to hang out with you or anyone else anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What are you talking about...?
Can't you just explain what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's nothing to explain, so quit following me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you do keep doing this, we'll never talk again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This is fine...
This is how things need to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika and Honami are both incredibly nice people. So nice that they don't care how cold I am towards them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But that's also why I don't want to cause them any trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't want either of them to suffer because of what I do.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She'll be fine as long as she has them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki will smile as long as those two are smiling alongside her...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should be practicing playing my bass instead...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The more time I have to myself, the more time I can spend practicing and playing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to practice as much as humanly possible if I really am going to become a professional bassist...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It feels so muggy on the rooftop now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wish I could practice in an open classroom, but that's not gonna happen anytime soon.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just have to move to the shade.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Okay, one more time.
This song's pretty hard, but I should be able to play it if I take it one step at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Good...
Just keep it up through the end and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes.
Start to finish without any mistakes.
I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean to eavesdrop...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can listen all you want...

Oh, I...
I was thinking about having lunch up here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(That's pretty odd.
I've never seen anyone else come up here by themselves to have lunch.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I won't be able to practice if she's here...
But there's nowhere else for me to go.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess she won't be that much of a bother...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Finally, school's out.
I can go up to the rooftop and work on my bass...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika and Honami are just outside the door. It definitely looks like they're waiting for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(If that's how they're gonna play...
I'll just go out the back.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What in the world is going on with Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I don't know...
It's not like her to leave us in the dark like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have to think something's really bothering her. It may also be about us based on how she's been avoiding us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that's true, I feel even more inclined to talk to her. Not being there for her when she needs our help is the last thing I want...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Avoiding them like this is only making them worry more about me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm not about to cause them any trouble.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Coming up here during lunch is one thing, but it's after school. She must not be in any clubs.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I still don't really know why she keeps coming up here, but I guess I should just leave her be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Anyway, I don't want to think about anything other than playing my bass right now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I've sort of gotten used to it.)
Oh, I apologize for interrupting you during practice, but there's something I'd like to ask you.
I see you up here all the time by yourself. Are you not in a band or anything...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have anyone else to play with...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A long time ago, I had some friends who wanted to be in a band...
But... Is it fun playing your bass all by yourself like this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? What are you saying?
I've definitely been getting better, so it's been worth it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, you have to know how to practice on your own if you want to become a professional bassist.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel at ease whenever I'm listening to music or playing my bass...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'm gonna keep practicing now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'm glad it's sunny again today.
Rain would've kept me from going up to the rooftop.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Hm...?
It sounds like someone's already up there...)

Um...
I bought it last week.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Last week?
Why all of a sudden?
That talk we had the other day...
It made me believe that I might not have to feel so alone if I learned to play music.

I'm not sure...
Maybe that's not the right word.
The thing is, I've had to switch schools so many times already. I have a hard time getting myself to make new friends since I don't know how long I'll be here...
At the same time, it felt like I was spending too much time on my own, so I decided to buy this.
Oh, would I be making too much of a racket...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I won't mind...
Feel free to practice as you like.

Really?
Thanks, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot to introduce myself to you...
My name's Miu Takagi, a second-year.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm Shiho Hinomori.
Also a second-year...

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: Ichika! Are you heading home now...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Uh, yes.
How did club activities go for you today?

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: The seniors are all hyped up for regionals, so they're making us practice extra hard! You should stop by for a change!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You had me going there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Or rather...
We used to be friends.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna play your bass...?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: It's just, you don't seem as lonely whenever you are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You should try using your fingertips more when fretting, especially for chords...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. That makes things so much easier. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I'll go up again today...)

Hey! You're Hinomori, right?
The second year?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: We're third-years from the Light Music Club!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Light Music Club?
I didn't realize our school had one of those...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
We literally just started it.
Our goal's to play during the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: But our bassist has some conflicts to deal with, so we're looking for someone experienced to replace her...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: That's when we heard about you, Hinomori. Wanna try playing bass for us?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
Oh...
It's already this late. We should head home soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Some third-years invited me to play for their band, so you might start seeing less of me up here starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: That's great. You found a band.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Huh? Did you say something just now?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I can hear my guitar so clearly when it's just me playing...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: At the same time, everything's so quiet...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: I can't wait to get started, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Same.
I've been looking forward to this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, why don't we jump right in?
We only have three months until the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Let's give it a quick run!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're pretty good. They might be more experienced than I realized...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If we really work at it starting now, we should be able to put on a great show for the School Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: Totally! I can't believe you figured everything out in one go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks.
I'm just glad I didn't disappoint any of you.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: I mean, we're pretty much all set now, right? There's not much else to work on...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
I know!
What if we started working on another song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think there's still some room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like you can make the snare sound a little more dynamic. Also, we might be able to sing and use the keyboard in a way to build up to the chorus better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would it be alright if we gave that a try?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: Okay, let's give it another shot.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
Haha. All good.
Just do better next time!

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line:
Oh, we should head home soon.
Let's start putting everything away.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Hey, wanna stop by a cafe on our way back? There's this new one that just opened by the station!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, can't we practice a little more since we have the time...?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: Where? We don't have anywhere to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll have to walk a little way, but I know this good studio that lets you rent for really cheap...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah... I get what you're trying to say, but breaks are important too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line:
She's right.
Practicing's important, but all work and no play, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
You should come with us, Hinomori!
What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
You sure?
Alright, I guess we'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The only good practice we've had so far was during our first day.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even asking them to practice on their own at home got tabled...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to do in this situation...?)

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
No, I did it again!
I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line:
Haha. That part's so hard too.
Oh, that reminds me. I found this great shop the other day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna go get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(We're not getting anything done.
All they do is talk and talk and talk...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Do they really think we're gonna be ready in time for the School Festival...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot to bring my wallet.
I'll just go back and...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: As good as Hinomori is, she's a pain to deal with, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, she takes everything way too seriously, like a teacher coaching one of the sports clubs.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: To her credit, she wants to go pro, but the rest of us just want to have fun playing at the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: Haha. I guess opposites don't really attract, huh?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, the School Festival's coming up, so let's just make sure we're decent enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Was that your plan this whole time...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you all at least had some desire to play “decent”...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that's not really the case, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: No, um... My tongue just slipped and...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line: C-Can't you see that we're trying really hard? We might not be taking this as seriously as you, Hinomori, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whether or not you're taking this seriously isn't the issue here! At the very least, you're supposed to work on fixing your mistakes...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Otherwise, there's no way we'll ever be able to put on a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
Who made you queen...?
You might be good, but that doesn't give you the right to berate us like that.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member B
rows.Line: H-Hold on, that was a little uncalled for, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: No, we're the ones who invited her to play with us, and she thanks us by ordering us around like this? Honestly, who does she think she is?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had no problem with you wanting to get in your last hurrah, but I'd like it if we could actually get things done during practice.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Members B & C
Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line:
Ugh...
We shouldn't have invited you...

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member A
rows.Line: All we really wanted was someone to play bass for us, not someone who's going to cause us this much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Light Music Club Member C
rows.Line:
I agree...
I mean, Hinomori, this can't be easy for you either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why does it always have to end this way...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My day-to-day life's one thing, but a part of me held out hope that it wouldn't have to be like that when it came to music...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
It was fun while it lasted.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Long time no see, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
The School Festival's coming up too.
Is your band gonna be ready in time?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Actually, no...
They kicked me out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our goals in terms of music were too different and we could never get on the same page...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm not sure I'd be able to get along with anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it just means that I'm not cut out for playing in a band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you have a committee meeting today, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
How'd club activities go for you today, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, the first years are coming along really nicely. They've been saying it's because I took the time to help them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They have? Good for you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you're still worried about Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's no hope for me there either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My unwillingness to bend is just gonna lead to more conflict.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's best for me to just be alone.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Hmm... Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You always seem so lonely when you're by yourself, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face...
They're your friends, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: The truth is, I really didn't know why I've been coming up here each day to play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: When I first met you up here, Hinomori, my goal was just to kill time...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Part of it was because you looked so cool playing your bass. It was like nothing else mattered to you.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You made me believe that I wouldn't have to feel the way I did if I started playing music...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
And playing my guitar did just that.
It put me at ease even when you weren't here.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I still find myself coming up here...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I guess that means I don't actually want to be alone...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
You feel the same way, right, Hinomori?
You want someone by your side... You want your friends to be there with you.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But you're really gonna give up just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: You're really just gonna toss that band and your friends aside...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho, did you see?
We get to be in the same class during our first year!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so glad we're all together...!
Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I believe that we both have to find a way to move forward. We have to work to get out of whatever “ruts” we're in right now...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Just as I started playing my guitar, you tried your hand at joining a band.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: We have to keep making these changes one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: With that in mind, I have to change schools again next month...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
It's okay. I'm used to it now.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
I can play music now.
So I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I plan on trying a little more at my next school.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Things might go well, but they might not. Whenever I feel sad or dejected, I'll just play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I don't plan on giving up. I'm gonna keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
So please, Hinomori...
Do the same.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
No...
I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want someone to be there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want them to be there...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But you're really gonna give up just like that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't go back now, and I have no way to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is all I can really do for the time being...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The end...
That's the story of my life in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho was watching us the entire time from the rooftop...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (While we could do nothing for her...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Like I said before...
The point of me doing this wasn't to make you all feel this way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's proof that we didn't understand what you were going through back then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If only we'd taken the time to actually sit down and talk with you, like we did with Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You wouldn't have had to go through what you did...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was the one who did the least out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, don't beat yourselves up over this. The moral of my story is that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That you're glad you didn't give up, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Back then, I just couldn't give up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd convinced myself that we couldn't really be friends anymore, but deep down, I was hoping that we could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
As a result, I had to suffer for it.
I was so afraid that I'd end up creating more problems instead of solving them. However...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I endured, and I was rewarded with Ichika and Saki getting our band back together. I'm here today because I didn't give up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that I held on to my music, and more importantly, all of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad music... No, I'm glad you found a way back to your friends, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm super duper happy that we managed to get our band back together too, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Stop it, you two...
I'm getting all teary-eyed just listening.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-It's too hard for me not to...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You should see what you all look like in the mirror.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, do you know what happened to your friend from the rooftop? Takagi, was it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sadly, I don't...
We were really only friends when we were up there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She didn't tell me which class she was in either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should thank her if we do ever run into her! After all, she's the one who told you not to give up, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
Do you think she's still playing her guitar...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Who knows?
She might've moved on to something else by now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you two became connected through music, so I'm sure you're still tied together somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe. You could be right.
Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope we run into each other again someday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your story sort of had the effect of turning this entire day into an afterparty, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In place of discussing what to do for our next show. But I guess that can wait until tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. You can leave the scheduling to me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is somebody doing a street performance?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I hear it too!
I think it's a girl singing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too.
It's so gentle and heartwarming...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Thank you for stopping by today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I think that was her last song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
No, I wanna hear more.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Same.
I wonder when she'll be playing next.

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Yeah, you drew a huge crowd even though it was your first time performing here!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Of course!
We're your best friends! We plan on seeing every single one of your performances!

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
Haha. All of them?
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line:
But you've improved a lot.
Can I get your autograph before you get a record deal?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think that song's called? Did she write it herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It'd be great if we could write something like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'd like that as well...!
What do you think, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I really liked it too...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
...
Nevermind. I thought I saw someone I knew just now...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: My first actual friend, I think...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I'm glad you figured it out, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...!
Can we try that again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, from the top.
Also, Saki, try to slow down a little for this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Did I jump ahead just now?
I couldn't tell at all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here's a recording of what we just did.
It should give you a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
Nothing gets by you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I need to be able to do at least this much. Ichika, ready for another go?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My, they really mean business today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know, right? Shiho's pushing the girls fairly hard, but they're responding beautifully.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright!
It's time for me to get pumped too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika! I know you can sing more clearly during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Nobody can change their past...
The pain you felt back then stays with you forever.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It has ways of rearing its ugly head each time you look back...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But that pain is also the reason why Shiho's here now, and she couldn't be happier.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That was good.
Let's try to repeat what we just did! Once more!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Shiho...
